name: CycPepNet
description: Open framework that compares molecular representations and machine-learning models for cyclic-peptide binding affinity, membrane permeability and half-life, covering 20 regression and classification tasks.

limitations: Prediction archives exist for only part of the historical run set; The NPMMPD input is a different snapshot from Figshare v1 and the matching version must be requested; The PEPlife2 original export query and selected fields must be recovered; The PepTherDia cyclic-selection predicate, scraper and page order have not been recovered; The Macrocycle-DB live export API is not a verified recipe and historical versions must be requested; Only the PepMSND data has a verified data licence

attributes.source_locator: description: README first two paragraphs; the 12/8 split derives from benchmark.py supplementary markings; task: README for properties, thresholds, representations and tuning; benchmark.py for random and Butina split methods
attributes.task: Predict binding affinity (OPRM1 Ki, MC4R Ki, SSTR2 IC50), membrane permeability and half-life of cyclic peptides, as regression or as classification with fixed thresholds (Ki/IC50 ≤ 100 nM, log permeability ≥ −6, half-life ≥ 8 h). Random and Butina (Morgan fingerprint) splits are provided; hyperparameters are tuned on the validation split and models are scored on test.
